title: Add Group Token And Fragment Choreography
summary: Added a renderer-neutral group, token, and temporary-fragment hierarchy with token anchors, bounded cohesion, explicit DOM/texture/mesh provenance, immutable semantic authority, and exhaustive native-renderer settlement. The radical fixture binds the existing opposite-corner fold/bundle/swap motif to this contract without making motion fragments semantic inspection targets.
